facts.text: At Young Harris College, all required textbooks are included in tuition at no extra cost to students.

sources.title: Tuition and fees - Young Harris College
sources.quote: That's why textbooks are included in your tuition at no extra cost, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in your chosen subjects.

sources.title: Financial Aid & Scholarships | Young Harris College
sources.quote: At YHC, your tuition covers all required textbooks. You'll start each semester with the materials you need, already paid for.
